title: Seem to be a little fragile
text: Seem to be a little fragile. When I received them one of the larger ones was broke in the box. As I was unpacking them and putting them in my dishwasher, I barely tapped one against another and a second one broke. They’re nice looking, Just seem a little fragile even though the glass isn’t real thin.
